row: Flip Flops Animal Sanctuary is a vegan operated 501 (c)3 certified nonprofit organization. We specialize in helping neglected or abused farm animals live their best life on sanctuary. We currently care for approximately 70 rescued animals on our small sanctuary in Southern Maryland.
